title: Split Gateway Traffic 80/20 Across Services
prompt:
Namespace `cka-canary` serves Services `app-v1` and `app-v2` on port `80` behind an existing Gateway named `edge-canary` (`gatewayClassName: eg`).

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create `HTTPRoute` `canary-route` in namespace `cka-canary` attached to Gateway `edge-canary` for hostname `canary.cka.local`.
2. Split HTTP traffic with weight `80` to `app-v1` (port `80`) and weight `20` to `app-v2` (port `80`).
3. Verify HTTPRoute `canary-route` is Accepted and Service `app-v1` exposes active endpoints.
hints: Place both `app-v1` and `app-v2` inside `rules[0].backendRefs` with explicit `weight: 80` and `weight: 20`.
Verify acceptance via `k -n cka-canary describe httproute canary-route`.
fast_solution_commands: k -n cka-canary get svc app-v1 app-v2

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app-v1
  namespace: cka-canary
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app-v1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app-v1
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app-v2
  namespace: cka-canary
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app-v2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app-v2
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: app-v1
  namespace: cka-canary
spec:
  selector:
    app: app-v1
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: app-v2
  namespace: cka-canary
spec:
  selector:
    app: app-v2
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: edge-canary
  namespace: cka-canary
spec:
  gatewayClassName: eg
  listeners:
  - name: http
    protocol: HTTP
    port: 80
    hostname: canary.cka.local
    allowedRoutes:
      namespaces:
        from: Same

checks.description: Service `app-v1` exposes at least 1 ready endpoint

manifests:
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: canary-route
  namespace: cka-canary
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: edge-canary
  hostnames:
  - canary.cka.local
  rules:
  - backendRefs:
    - name: app-v1
      port: 80
      weight: 80
    - name: app-v2
      port: 80
      weight: 20
